visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a white t-shirt stands in a bright, modern kitchen, stirring food in a black cast iron pot resting on an induction burner. The background features various kitchen utensils and soft indoor lighting. (2) Close-up shot of hands using a chef's knife to slice sausages into thin rounds on a yellow plastic cutting board. The movement is rhythmic and precise. (3) The hands move to a white onion, slicing it into small cubes on the same yellow board, while a bowl of cooked white rice sits in the background. (4) Fresh green scallions are chopped finely, adding a vibrant green color to the prep area. (5) The black pot is heated on the induction cooktop until visible white steam rises from the surface, indicating high temperature. (6) Yellow whisked egg liquid is poured into the pot and stirred rapidly with black chopsticks, forming soft curds. (7) A black spatula is used to break the cooked eggs into smaller pieces within the pot, ensuring they don't stick to the bottom. (8) The previously chopped sausages, onions, and scallions are added sequentially to the pot and tossed with the eggs. (9) A tray of cold white rice is emptied into the pot. The cook uses a spatula to press and separate the rice grains. (10) A demonstration of flipping and stirring the rice at a high pace follows, showing the non-stick property of the seasoned pot. (11) Red ketchup is squeezed from a bottle into the mixture, followed by sprinkles of salt and pepper, and a splash of soy sauce. (12) The finished reddish-orange fried rice is served on a white plate. A shot of the empty black pot shows it is clean with no stuck-on rice. (13) Several close-up shots showcase the texture of the rice grains and the variety of ingredients on the plate. (14) A supplemental section shows the initial rice cooking process, including adding oil to the water and closing the lid of the cast iron pot.

(5) [Subtitle]: 一人份 大約需要4分之1顆. (6) [Subtitle]: 切都切了... 順便連蔥花也切好了... (7) [Subtitle]: 中火熱鍋兩分鐘... (8) [Subtitle]: 等冒出白煙 關火30秒... (9) [Subtitle]: 轉弱火加熱，倒入油. (10) [Subtitle]: 好啦，換女兒來表演！. (11) [Subtitle]: 放入蛋液之後，用筷子攪攪拌.. (12) [Subtitle]: 看到蛋液底部凝固了 推一邊去... (13) [Subtitle]: 接著慢慢炒成蛋碎... (14) [Variety]: 挑戰第一關成功 煎蛋不沾. (15) [Subtitle]: 繼續放入德國香腸. (16) [Subtitle]: 繼續炒香... (35) [Variety]: 鑄鐵鍋炒飯 沒沾喔！. (36) [Subtitle]: 一開始不明白為什麼 女兒炒飯要加番茄醬？. (37) [Subtitle]: 但還蠻好吃的耶！ 哈哈. (38) [Subtitle]: 鑄鐵鍋炒飯米粒很香 很好吃！！. (39) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @Ros. (40) [Variety]: 秘 煮飯的小訣竅. (41) [Subtitle]: 煮飯的時候可以加 稍微多一點橄欖油 水量減少10cc. (42) [Subtitle]: 用浸水縮短的模式 米飯會更粒的感覺. (43) [Subtitle]: 煮好後，悶5分鐘再開蓋. (44) [Subtitle]: 水蒸氣滴進去沒關係喔！. (45) [Subtitle]: 煮好之後，立刻鬆一下飯. The tempo is approximately 140 BPM, creating a lively atmosphere. (2) A female narrator with a calm, friendly, and professional tone begins speaking in Traditional Chinese, describing the recipe steps. Her voice is clear and well-enunciated. (3) Sharp, percussive rhythmic clicking sounds are heard as the knife hits the cutting board during the ingredient preparation phase. (4) A consistent, broadband white noise sizzling sound occurs as the eggs and later the rice are added to the hot pot. (5) Low-frequency scraping and clinking sounds from the spatula and chopsticks interacting with the cast iron pot are layered over the music. (6) Soft digital beeps from the induction cooktop interface signal adjustments in heat settings. (7) The music continues throughout the entire duration, maintaining a consistent energy level, while the narration pauses strategically to let the cooking sounds be heard.

It also serves as a lifestyle vlog showcasing mother-daughter interaction in the kitchen.
